name: Kat Attack!
source:
During a heated discussion, space pirate Kat and boyfriend Draco are interrupted by an assassin named Viper seeking a blood vendetta.
Viper claiming that Kat had murdered his uncle, takes a shot at her but Draco steps in and takes the bullet.
Kat immediately disposes of Viper in a blind rage, and is left with his lover's dying breath.

Thankfully she has experienced the magic of the few remaining Mystics in the known universe, and knows that with their magic he can be brought back to life.

Upon arriving at their temple she is told that there is a magical root at the heart of the Astrom tree - the Astromaly that can grant her the ability to contact the Audiolympians and be taught the song of life.

With her newfound knowledge she sets out to obtain the Astromaly, prodding vicious black market mobsters who may know if its whereabouts. What she doesn't know is that Triton,head of the ASEC private army and a relative of the recently deceased Viper is hot on her trail ready to continue the cycle of revenge. Not only that but her arch-nemesis Eris is closely working with him to bring Kat to an end.

With her trusty stratoblaster ( a guitar gun which also doubles as an interstellar surfboard ) and her trusty sidekick Orion she is ready to take on anything that stands in her way!
translation:
在一场激烈的讨论中，太空海盗凯特和男友德拉科被一名寻求血仇的刺客毒蛇打断。
毒蛇声称凯特谋杀了他的叔叔，并向她开了一枪，但德拉科介入并挡住了子弹。
凯特在盲目的愤怒中立即处理掉了毒蛇，留下了他爱人的垂死呼吸。

值得庆幸的是，她体验过已知宇宙中仅存的几位神秘主义者的魔法，并且知道用他们的魔法可以让他复活。

到达他们的寺庙后，她被告知在阿斯特罗姆树的中心有一个神奇的根部——阿斯特罗姆，它可以赋予她与奥奥林匹亚人联系并学习生命之歌的能力。

凭借她新发现的知识，她开始寻找星象书，并刺激邪恶的黑市暴徒，他们可能知道它的下落。她不知道的是，ASEC私人军队的负责人、最近去世的Viper的亲戚Triton正在紧追不舍，准备继续复仇的循环。不仅如此，她的宿敌厄里斯也在与他密切合作，以终结凯特。

凭借她值得信赖的平层冲击器（一把吉他枪，也可用作星际冲浪板）和她值得信赖的伙伴猎户座，她已准备好应对任何阻碍她的事情！
